detailed_sections.section_number_and_title: 7.1 Drivers of Urban Growth and City Typologies
detailed_sections.full_notes: Urbanization is driven by industrialization, employment opportunities, and infrastructure expansion. Cities range from historical planned grid cities (Jaipur), industrial manufacturing centers, pilgrimage cities (Varanasi), to technology/knowledge clusters (Bengaluru IT hub).

margin_notes_and_sidebars.title: Jaipur Grid Planning
margin_notes_and_sidebars.content: Founded in 1727 by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II, Jaipur was designed based on Vastu Shastra grid geometry with wide axial avenues.

detailed_sections.full_notes: Rapid migration creates challenges: informal slum settlements, traffic congestion, poor Air Quality Index (AQI), and water scarcity. Community-driven initiatives like Bengaluru's citizen lake restoration projects demonstrate sustainable urban ecological revival.

margin_notes_and_sidebars.title: Community Lake Revival
margin_notes_and_sidebars.content: Citizen groups in Bengaluru partnered with civic authorities to desilt polluted urban lakes, restoring local groundwater recharge.

stem_lab_drawers.aim_or_objective: To assess land-use patterns and civic infrastructure in a municipal urban ward.
procedure_or_steps: Categorize land use into Commercial, Residential, Industrial, and Green Park zones.
Identify public transport stops, waste segregation collection points, and storm drains.
Evaluate urban challenges: traffic bottleneck spots, litter accumulation, and pedestrian walkway safety.
stem_lab_drawers.observations_or_results: Reveals spatial conflicts between commercial expansion and pedestrian residential safety.
stem_lab_drawers.conclusion_or_principle: Integrated master planning is vital to balancing economic growth with livability.

formula_calculators.formula_expression: Urbanization % = (Urban Population / Total Population) * 100 — Measures the proportion of national population residing in legally defined urban municipal areas.
formula_calculators.description: India's urbanization rate is steadily increasing toward 35-40%.
